peers.title: Servers
peers.subtitle: paired HydraHive servers (via Tailscale)
peers.step1: 1. Create this server's pairing code and paste it on the other server
peers.url_hint: Address under which the other server reaches this one. It must be the Tailscale address (100.x.y.z) – filled in automatically when Tailscale is connected.
peers.url_not_tailnet: This is not a Tailscale address. Pairing only works over Tailscale – tasks will never arrive at this address. Connect Tailscale (Admin → System → Tailscale) and enter the 100.x.y.z address.
peers.step2: 2. Paste the other server's pairing code here
peers.confirm_hint: Compare fingerprints: read it on the other server under “Pair server” and type it here.
peers.agents_hint: The partner server may task these agents:
peers.auto_tools_warning: At least one released agent runs tools without confirmation. Tasks from the partner server then run unchecked – enable “Confirm tools” in these agents' settings.
peers.call_hint: Call from the other server: ask_agent("<agent name or ID>@{{server}}")

catalog.hub_hint: This server sends its catalog to {{server}}.
catalog.only_active: Can be turned on once the pairing is active.
catalog.sync_subtitle: Send ideas and tasks (metadata only) to the hub
catalog.sync_hint: Sending follows in a later stage; for now only the settings are stored.
catalog.hub_none: No hub selected – turn on “Use as hub” for an active server above.
catalog.interval_invalid: Please enter a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.
catalog.users_label: Users whose ideas and tasks are sent
catalog.users_none_selected: No user selected yet – nothing will be sent.
catalog.switch_hub_confirm: {{from}} is already the hub. Switch to {{to}}? The catalog will then be fully re-synced.
catalog.sync_now_inactive: Nothing sent: sync is off, no active hub or no user selected.

reason.peer_catalog_not_accepted: The hub does not accept the catalog yet (turn on “Accept catalog” there).
reason.peer_unknown: The hub does not know this server or has blocked it.
reason.peer_signature_invalid: The hub rejects the signature (check the pairing).
reason.peer_expired: The hub rejects the message as too old (check the clock).
reason.peer_rate_limited: The hub is throttling (too many messages), the next run will retry.
reason.peer_replay: The hub rejects the message number, the next run will retry.
reason.peer_payload_too_large: Message too large for the hub.
reason.hub_bad_ack: The hub did not acknowledge correctly.
reason.sync_failed: Sync failed (details in the server log).
reason.source_failed: A data source (ideas or tasks) could not be read.
